author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv dual-expert (task-aware + pre-norm, clip=1.0) — BiGRU=192, seed=7
abstract: Capacity ablation replicate: increase BiGRU from 160→192 within shared-backbone task-aware config (mean_lse_mix for non-ncRNA; mean_max_mix for ncRNA). Tests if larger RNN lifts CRI-On/PRS without harming ncRNA. Clip=1.0, pre-LN ON.
